about: The dismissal of the Easter Vigil and temporal Masses within the Easter octave. Two Alleluias are added to both the dismissal and its response.

seg.nr: The deacon turns toward the people and sings the dismissal, or the priest himself sings it.

seg.tr: Go forth, the Mass is ended. Alleluia, alleluia.

nt.w008: As a noun, “missa” means dismissal. The same form can be a participle of “mitto,” meaning “sent.” A participial reading would require an understood subject that the formula does not name.

seg.tr: Thanks be to God. Alleluia, alleluia.

ex.w011: The response leaves the verb unspoken. Its full sense is “we give thanks to God”.

seg.nr: At temporal Masses within the Easter octave, two Alleluias are added to the dismissal and response.
